# Skip

> > Skip is an AI-powered platform providing payment processing, business tools, and grant opportunities for small businesses and entrepreneurs across the United States.

Skip offers integrated payment services, AI-powered business tools (including image generation and product galleries), and runs multiple grant programs including weekly $1K instant grants and partnerships like the Santander Cultivate program offering up to $20K for food entrepreneurs. The platform serves diverse small businesses across major U.S. cities.

## Key Topics

- Skip payment processing
- Small business grants
- AI business tools
- Skip AI Image Generator
- Instant $1K grants
- Payment services
- Business profiles
- Entrepreneur funding
- U.S. small businesses
- Product gallery features
- Santander Cultivate grants
- Skip Team
- Business automation
- Customer payments
- Skip Platinum pricing

## Grant Programs

- [Skip's Instant Grants ($1,000) | Live Small Business Grants Multiple Times Weekly](https://helloskip.com/grants/skip-1k-grants): Live $1K grant drawings for U.S. entrepreneurs, multiple times weekly
- [Cultivate Small Business Program: Up to $20,000 in Capital Grants](https://helloskip.com/grants/santander-grants): Santander's $20K grant program for food-industry entrepreneurs
